purpose: Curated, public real-data examples for import validation. Records describe how to obtain data, required companion annotation, and safe checks. They do not bundle data, run remote downloads, or imply that all records are executable Shiny routes.

required_checks: assembly or reference build agrees with the assay/genotype data
gene ID namespace is recorded and count/feature IDs are mapped explicitly
chromosome naming is compatible between annotation, VCF/BED, and reference
gene intervals have valid chromosome/start/end coordinates
gene_annotation_contract.go_policy: Use a dated organism-specific GAF plus a reviewed identifier mapping. GO annotations are never inferred from gene symbols.

input_contract.gene_annotation: required before interval, GO, or gene-model interpretation; obtain the original compatible annotation after confirming the source build

expected_checks: count columns exactly match metadata sample_id after import
eight samples and two treatment levels are present
counts are non-negative integers
PCA, DE table, MA plot, and volcano plot are produced

input_contract.processed_data: inspect supplementary files before routing: DESeq2 requires integer counts; TPM/FPKM requires a normalized-expression workflow
input_contract.contrast: control vs drought, optionally stratified by tissue
input_contract.gene_annotation: must match the genome build and identifier namespace reported by the selected GEO files; do not assume NAM-5.0 compatibility

expected_checks: sample metadata retains control/drought and ear/leaf/kernel labels
matrix type is detected before selecting a DE method
sample IDs align exactly
PCA, contrast-specific DE table, MA plot, and volcano plot are produced

input_contract.processed_peak_data: narrowPeak/BED coordinates plus explicit assembly from ENCODE file metadata
input_contract.gene_annotation: must use the exact reference assembly recorded by the selected ENCODE files
input_contract.route_scope: processed-peak import, interval annotation, peak-width/distribution/signal summaries; not raw read peak calling

expected_checks: peak coordinates are valid and consistently named
selected file metadata supplies a reference assembly
annotation chromosome labels match peak labels
peak annotation and QC summaries are produced

download.method: download one NAM phenotype and create a matching VCF subset
download.recommended_initial_scope: 100-300 overlapping lines, one quantitative trait, one chromosome

input_contract.genotypes: bgzip VCF plus tabix index, or an explicitly converted PLINK dataset
input_contract.gene_annotation: must match the VCF reference assembly; record this in the manifest

expected_checks: VCF and phenotype sample IDs overlap and duplicates are reported
variants pass coordinate, missingness, and MAF checks
phenotype is numeric with sufficient non-missing lines
PCA/kinship, Manhattan, QQ, GWAS table, and annotation-ready loci are produced

download.method: download a VCF subset for selected accessions and one AraPheno phenotype CSV

input_contract.genotypes: VCF subset with accession identifiers retained
input_contract.phenotypes: AraPheno values plus original accession IDs
input_contract.gene_annotation: TAIR10-compatible annotation only after the VCF reference has been confirmed

expected_checks: accession-ID mapping is explicit rather than inferred
VCF and phenotype sample overlap is reported
trait transformation, covariate policy, and GWAS model are recorded
PCA/kinship, Manhattan, QQ, and annotated lead-locus outputs are produced

input_contract.gene_annotation: feature table is sufficient for clustering; compatible GTF is additionally required for interval, GO, or gene-model interpretation
input_contract.route_scope: QC, normalization, variable genes, PCA/UMAP, clustering, marker discovery

expected_checks: matrix/features/barcodes dimensions agree
UMI counts are non-negative integers
cell and gene QC are reported before clustering
PCA/UMAP, cluster summary, and marker-gene table are produced
